% A guard: it checks a case that the fix of the files that name themselves
% with \ProvidesFile must not break.
% A bibliography style beside the document, debug.bbx, that biblatex
% reads with the primitive \input from biblatex.sty, as for a modified
% copy of reading.bbx. The style names itself \ProvidesFile{debug.bbx},
% so tex4ht reads debug.4ht, as for a style of the tree. As in the PDF,
% the citation's entry is in the page. debug.4ht defines
% \bbx@subfieldlabel, which the style does not have, so the page shows
% that it was read: the page's last sentence, which the PDF does not have.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[backend=bibtex,bibstyle=debug,citestyle=numeric]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{test-biblatex-authoryear.bib}
\begin{document}
Some text, as cited in \cite{book}.
\printbibliography
\makeatletter
\ifdefined\bbx@subfieldlabel Read for the web.\fi
\makeatother
\end{document}
